title: Strategy Restarts Bitcoin Buying, Spending $370 Million

title: Gold Slips as Renewed Mideast Tensions Keep Fed Hike Bets Alive

title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Strikes Spur Rally in Oil: Markets Wrap

title: Dollar Weakens for a Second Month on Treasury Buyback

title: Ninth Circuit Opinion Provided 'More Confusion Than Clarity,' Says Kalshi Board Member
summary: Brian Quintenz, KalshiEx Board Member and former CFTC Commissioner, said that the recent decision handed down by the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals provided the company and customers 'more confusion than clarity' when it ruled sports prediction markets can be prosecuted as unlicensed sportsbooks. Quintenz said that prediction market regulation will come down to the Supreme Court to define and that within the law events that have 'any financial, commercial or economic consequence' can have legal derivatives listed upon it because it involved risk.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Vanguard Index Fund Celebrates 50th Birthday
summary: Eric Balchunas marks the 50th anniversary of the first index fund, the Vanguard 500 Index Fund. It launched on August 31st, 1976 and eventually led the way for passive investing. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: People Trying Hard To 'Outfox' S&P 500: Cutright
summary:
Brooks Cutright, portfolio manager at Hedgeye Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." Index tracking funds have nearly $27 trillion tied to the S&P 500. This Friday the S&P 500 is set to announce who may be added or taken out of the index as part of a rebalancing. Thirty-six companies appear to qualify for entry, while more than 110 existing members no longer meet the index's market-cap hurdle.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Small Cap Full of 'Horrible' Cos.: Panitsas
summary:
Nick Panitsas, CIO of Farther Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss 'Boomer candy' ETFs, the outperformance of Avantis US Small Cap Value ETF (Ticker: AVUV), and active ETFs.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Data Center Investment Will Make Communities Better, Says Rep. McCormick
summary: Republican Congressman from Georgia Rich McCormick said that there's a lot of 'misinformation' around data centers and that communities with data centers will see improvements and lower property taxes from the outside investment. McCormick also weighed in on strikes between Iran and the US, saying he backed military involvement because the IRGC doesn't understand 'anything other than strength.'  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Yen Breach of 160 Revives Japan Intervention Watch Ahead of BOJ
summary: The yen’s breach of 160 versus the dollar underscores the currency’s vulnerability to further weakness and the risk that authorities enter the market again to slow its decline.

title: Investors Bet on a Hair Loss Treatment Boom
summary: Drugmakers are developing a new generation of hair loss treatments, including lotions, pills and longer-lasting injections, targeting a US market where tens of millions of men and women experience pattern hair loss. Joining Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend is Bloomberg News Equities Reporter Avalon Pernell says some treatments could seek approval and reach the market as soon as 2027, drawing investor interest in companies hoping to tap consumers already willing to spend heavily on hair restoration. (Source: Bloomberg)
